push.title: L 2-4 vs Fish Academy | You: 8.3
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.3 is a good day. Not a great one yet, but good is the step before great.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Fish Academy. Defenders can draw up all the plans they want; you just scored anyway.
+ 1 assist. Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ Your vision plus PhogsToffees's finishing equals a very happy coach.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Gold star, no notes.
+ Team-high 24 passes attempted. Keep that in your back pocket.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Here's the play: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes. Easy money.
- 67% passing (16 of 24). For next time: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. You'll thank me later.
- You and buddskees both got caught on defensive work rate. Fix it together: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- In our wins you average 68% shot accuracy; here it was 33%. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- 4 goals conceded: -0.1. Easy upgrade available.

Garden drill: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Heart wins the fifty-fifties.

Write one of these on your hand next match. I'm serious. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-4 vs Fish Academy | You: 7.5
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.5. You've got more in the tank, and we're gonna go find it together.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at Fish Academy's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 1 key pass. You see the field like a hawk sees a cornfield.
+ BellyTb1 owes you a milkshake for those passes.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (6). That doesn't happen by accident.
+ Team-high 4 tackles attempted. That's a habit, and habits win leagues.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 4 on target. Think about this: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.
- 70% passing (14 of 20, down from your usual 82%). Little homework: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
- BellyTb1 struggled with forcing passes too. Work on it as a pair: give each other short options.
- Match 9 of the session and your rating had slid from 8.9 early on to 7.5. That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Missed tackles 3, up from your usual 2. We don't hide from that one; we fix it.

Five-minute drill: We're hitting the target, so now aim for the corners. Keepers love a shot down the middle.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: Hope is a plan with its shoes untied. Tie 'em.

Keep your chin up and your effort higher. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-4 vs Fish Academy | You: 6.6
push.body:
buddskees, a 6.6. If you ever wonder whether I've got your back, the answer is always.

THE GOOD
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (0). Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Try this: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost. Simple as Sunday.
- You and BellyTb1 can fix defensive work rate as a duo: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Next match: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 2. Let's not make that a pattern.
- 4 goals conceded dropped 0.1. Simple fix.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 50%, down from your usual 75%. That's below the line we drew together, and the line is the line. Fundamentals: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
! Match rating 6.6, down from your usual 8.4. You were a passenger. We need drivers.

Training note: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

One thought for the road, buddskees: Every pro was once an amateur who didn't quit.

Rome wasn't built in a day; neither is a great player. - Coach Lasso
